findings.where: First screen, the action: the white box 'Mark.Moseley@MMMinfra.com →' under 'Write to me at' (desktop and phone)
findings.fault: The page's one primary action goes nowhere. parts.txt gives its target as '#', not a mail link, so clicking the address does not open a message to Mark. The dispatch names only the photographs as stand-ins, so this is not a declared placeholder. The arrow after the address also suggests it leads to another page rather than opening an email.
findings.who_objects: A development-bank officer who clicks the one obvious way to reach Mark and gets nothing. Their only way round is to copy the address by hand. This is the one action the brand sheet (§1) and the brief ask this first screen to deliver.

findings.where: First screen, the row of topic pills under the lead: 'PPP Law', 'Infrastructure', 'Development banks', 'Governments', 'Risk allocation' (desktop and phone)
findings.fault: These are static labels, but each one is drawn as a rounded box with a white outline and short label. That is the shape of a filter chip or an outlined button, and they sit just above the real action. A click on any of them does nothing (parts.txt: static, draws its own box).
findings.who_objects: A visitor looking for Mark's work on one subject, such as PPP law, who clicks 'PPP Law' expecting his articles on it and gets no response. They then have to wonder which boxes on the field actually do something.

findings.where: Article specimen: the 'Streamlining the PPP Process…' PDF link and the list bullets above it
findings.fault: The article's only link is set in an orange-red that the palette does not include. The palette assigns blue to links, and the page's other text link ('Play again') is blue. The bullets of the list above are the same orange-red, so in the article that colour marks both a link and plain decoration.
findings.who_objects: A reader of Mark's articles, who has to learn two link colours on one site. They also see a colour that means 'link' used on bullets that do nothing, which weakens the cue they rely on to spot the PDFs, the product the research says rewards depth.

findings.fault: This is a button that replays the animation in place, but it is styled as an underlined blue text link, the look the page uses for going somewhere.
findings.who_objects: Few would notice. A careful visitor might expect it to open a page or video and be briefly surprised when the animation replays in place.
